items.description: Restrict GCP resource creation to approved organizational regions (e.g., us-east1, us-central1).
items.recommended_value: Restrict to authorized data sovereignty regions
items.remediation_notes: Maintain strict exception approval workflow for international regions.

items.description: Prevent developers from creating new user-managed Service Account JSON keys.
items.remediation_notes: Ensure no project overrides exist without CISO exception ticket.

items.control_name: Configure Security Essential Contacts at Organization Root
items.description: Ensure 'SECURITY' notification category has verified security operations email addresses.
items.recommended_value: Verified SOC/Security distribution list assigned to SECURITY category

items.control_name: Cloud Asset Inventory Real-time Export Feed to BigQuery
items.description: A continuous Cloud Asset Inventory feed must be configured to export resource changes to BigQuery for audit trails.
items.remediation_notes: Monitor BigQuery dataset permissions to prevent unauthorized schema changes.
